items.title: Estee Lauder (EL) Q4 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: Estee Lauder (EL) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +21.88% and +2.15%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Estee Lauder shares jump as fiscal 2027 profit forecast tops estimates
items.summary: Investing.com -- Estee Lauder shares jumped after the beauty company forecast full-year profit above Wall Street estimates, betting on sustained demand for premium fragrances and strong performance in key markets as its turnaround strategy continues to bear fruit.

items.title: Estee Lauder Narrows Loss as Sales Climb
items.summary: The Estee Lauder Companies narrowed its fiscal fourth-quarter loss on higher sales, as the company’s turnaround continued to pick up steam.

items.title: Estée Lauder Shares Rise as Fiscal 2027 Profit Outlook Beats Forecasts
items.summary: Estée Lauder (NYSE:EL) shares moved sharply higher after the beauty group issued a fiscal 2027 profit forecast that came in above Wall Street expectations, supported by resilient demand for premium fragrances and improving performance across important markets. The company also delivered better-than-expected fourth-quarter results.

items.title: The Estée Lauder Cos. Reports 6 Percent Sales Increase in Q4
items.summary: The beauty company touted a strong performance across most categories and regions, with North America driving growth.

items.title: Estée Lauder stock jumps as sales beat estimates
items.summary: Estée Lauder Cos. posted quarterly results that beat estimates and ended a run of three straight declines in annual revenue, a sign the beauty conglomerate's turnaround efforts are gaining momentum.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: SK Hynix, La-Z-Boy, Unitree, Target
items.summary: ↗️ SK Hynix (SKHY, KR:000660): The chip giant announced plans for a $28 billion buyback. Its U.S.-listed shares jumped in premarket trading. Earlier, its Korean shares closed nearly 10% lower amid a selloff in Asia.
